var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons

Grants 20|35|40 Inventory Size Stat to #element.

Total Ammo Reserves are determined by the Inventory Size and Magazine Stats.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons

Grants 20|35|40 Inventory Size Stat and Sword Guard Endurance to #element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Total Ammo Reserves are determined by the Inventory Size and Magazine Stats.

var element = <arc/>Arc Weapons

Grants 20|35|40 Inventory Size Stat to #element with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Total Ammo Reserves are determined by the Inventory Size and Magazine Stats.

Also grants the same stat bonuses to Guard Endurance for Swords of the same element.
